response.rationale: The confirmed total occlusion of the proximal right coronary artery (F09) with ST elevations (F08) and elevated troponin (F07) is diagnostic of acute inferior STEMI. The dextrocardia and situs inversus (F10, F11) explain the atypical ECG lead distribution and physical findings. Other differentials are contradicted by the presence of a coronary occlusion and lack of supporting features.
